notes.title: Instructions: Getting Started [UPDATED]
notes.content:
If you have any issues with getting started a single player game, we added some simple instructions here to help you get going. Keep in mind, our game requires that you launch the simple server to play locally as this was once an mmo.

1. The server needs to be on to play.
2. Install and load the simple server from Steam. 
(On the left side of your Steam Panel under "Games and Tools" Select "Tools".)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556861/781fa9e5f76d3ee85f68e3173280bdf27436c935.png[/img]

3. The option to download Fasaria World Server should now appear in your list under the client game. Select the server option and install the server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556861/d8cf7ccc2966fddd6950eeac746ca6d1b991d3cd.png[/img]

4, Once the server is installed, Select "Play" and then turn your server on by selecting "Unlock Server". Once on, a small green light will appear under "Server Status".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556861/4be6c9cf6405fb3f46cd6f6a4dafde641e7ab7e5.png[/img]

5. Now go back to your list and select the option for the actual game client, install it and then select "Play". Once the client loads, select start, agree to the terms and conditions, now select the first server option on the list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32556861/8bd296fd50e14b04a4d1e87d3502e2b9a1d31343.png[/img]

6. Create a new account. (You should see it appear in the server list).
7. Create a character.
8. Exit the first screen and start to play.

*Resolution options can also be changed but full screen will not work through Steam.

notes.title: Private Server Updates and Launch Info
notes.content:
Private Server Update:

We just added some new forum boards (some only viewable to game owners) and have updated the way we will help private servers get visibility. We want those who put up a private server to have player interaction from other members so we will be including a server list for active servers to appear directly on the client for other players to select from. It will be a limited list and we will be selecting only the most active servers to remain on the client list. We also have a discussion board now available for the servers not listed on the client to be viewed.

Launch Info:

We are preparing for the launch of the game (July 19th) and will be making some game and server updates over time. Remember that all members get client and server updates for free always.
